name: pixel
description: Pixel - a personal AI desktop companion for Windows
author: Pixel

scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:main && npm run build:native && cross-env CYPS_DEV=1 CYPS_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5199 electron --disable-gpu .
scripts.dev:electron:gpu: npm run build:main && npm run build:native && cross-env CYPS_DEV=1 CYPS_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5199 electron .
scripts.build:main: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node scripts/write-main-package.mjs && node scripts/build-preload.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && node scripts/make-icon.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron .
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:preload-sandbox: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && node scripts/test-preload-sandbox.mjs
scripts.test:native-uia-e2e: npm run build:main && npm run build:native && node scripts/test-native-uia-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:native-foreground: npm run build:native && cross-env PIXEL_FOREGROUND_INTEGRATION=1 vitest run tests/native-foreground.integration.test.ts
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run build:native && npm run build:voice-worker && electron-builder --win --dir --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:native && npm run build:voice-worker && electron-builder --win --publish never
